acceptanceCriteria: With the policy key absent or false, WORKER add is refused exactly as today.
With it true, WORKER add succeeds only for the held ticket's live attempt and in-scope anchors; stale attempts, other tickets and out-of-scope anchors are refused with stable codes.
The note records attempt and generation; KHN spec and the role/grant decision text are amended; maintained tests cover each refusal.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#671. Know-how notes (KHN-V0, #655) are writable only by OWNER (OPERATOR via explicit policy row); decisions 0443/0444 grant WORKER nothing, so dispatched workers who learn navigation facts keep an unscreened local store. Coordinator decision: add an opt-in policy key (e.g. knowHow.workerAdd, default false) that lets a WORKER run `ticket know-how add` only on the ticket where it holds a live attempt, only with anchors inside that attempt's effects.touchPaths (or a policy-declared prefix), with the existing 1024-byte, 4-anchor, 32-entry caps and secret screen, recording attempt and generation (V1-0964). Every other WORKER write stays refused with a stable code. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360), reporter on main-0b5096c; corvint-tasks build 202.
